description.narrative: Bidraget kommer att stödja den georgiska regeringen i genomförandet av dess reformagenda, i uppbyggnaden av institutionell kapacitet och i förbättringen av det politiska beslutsfattandet. Särskilt fönster för underprojekt om miljö och klimatförändringar som anges i bidraget. Bidraget är helt och hållet efterfrågestyrt - Georgiens regering kommer att ha möjlighet att ansöka om delprojekt som skulle stödja dess behov av kapacitetsuppbyggnad och konsulttjänster som svarar mot dess reform- och utvecklingsagenda.

The contribution will support Georgian Government in implementing its reform agenda, building institutional capacity, enhancing policy making. Special window for environmental and climate change sub-projects designated in the contribution. The Contribution is totally demand driven - Government of Georgia will have opportunity to apply for sub-projects that would support its needs in capacity building and consultancy services responding to its reform and development agenda.

The overall objective of the contribution is defined as "to accelerate structural transformation for sustainable development by enhancing citizen-centric governance systems for efficiently serving their constituencies."
For achieving the overall objective lower level objectives are defined as follows:
- Institutional and human capacity of targeted public agencies strengthened to better implement reforms for advancing public administration systems.
- The enabling environment created through advancing policy formulation and regulatory framework to address sectoral challenges in the field of democratic and environmental governance.
The implementation partner has developed indicators for measuring the progress towards the objectives and means of verification.
The key feature of the GRF for acheiving results lies in its demand-driven, quick response format, which allows the Government of Gerogia and UNDP GRF to address priority issues that emerge in the beneficiary institutions. It serves as a complementary tool to longer-term project-based work, which operates in a less flexible manner. The GRF uses the two mechanisms Capacity Development Fund (CDF) and On-Demeant Consultancy Services (DCS) as the pathways to achieve the goals set for the initiative.
